listing.name: Remove Trash Ships
listing.summary: A very simple mod that reduces the player faction's hullfrequency for basebp ships to 0.1.
listing.aiSummary: Reduces the spawn frequency of default base blueprints for the player faction.

description: Lowers the hull frequency of basic ships to 0.1, making them rare in fleets once blueprint packages are acquired. Essential utility ships like shuttles and tankers may still appear if no alternatives are known.
